ai-overview.title: Getting Started with AI Overviews
ai-overview.description: Follow these steps to optimize your content for Google AI Overviews and increase citation chances.

items.task: Audit current content for AI Overview optimization gaps
items.description: Review your top 10 pages and identify which ones could appear in AI Overviews

items.task: Create clear, concise 1-2 sentence answers to common questions
items.description: Ensure your content includes direct answers that AI models can easily cite

items.task: Implement schema markup (DefinedTerm, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList)
items.description: Add JSON-LD structured data to help Google understand your content

items.task: Build E-E-A-T signals (author bios, credentials, citations)
items.description: Display expertise, experience, authority, and trustworthiness prominently

items.task: Create comprehensive topic clusters with internal linking
items.description: Link related pages to establish topical authority

items.task: Monitor Google Search Console for AI Overview impressions
items.description: Track how often your content appears in AI Overviews

items.task: Test content with Google's AI Overviews preview tool
items.description: Use Search Console to see how your content appears in AI Overviews

items.task: Optimize for featured snippets (paragraph, list, table formats)
items.description: Featured snippets often feed into AI Overviews

generative-engine-optimization.title: Getting Started with GEO
generative-engine-optimization.description: Implement Generative Engine Optimization to rank in AI search engines like Perplexity and ChatGPT Search.

items.task: Identify which AI search engines your audience uses
items.description: Research Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude, and other platforms relevant to your niche

items.task: Create authoritative, citation-ready content
items.description: Write content that AI models will want to quote and attribute to your site

items.task: Implement LLMs.txt file for AI crawler instructions
items.description: Create /llms.txt with guidelines for how AI systems should cite your content

items.task: Build topical authority in your niche
items.description: Create comprehensive guides that cover all aspects of your topic

items.task: Use clear formatting (headers, lists, tables) for easy parsing
items.description: Make your content easy for AI models to extract and cite

items.task: Include original research and unique insights
items.description: AI models prefer citing original, authoritative sources

items.task: Add author credentials and expertise markers
items.description: Help AI systems understand why your content is authoritative

items.task: Monitor mentions in AI-generated responses
items.description: Track how often AI systems cite your content

core-web-vitals.title: Getting Started with Core Web Vitals
core-web-vitals.description: Improve your site's performance and ranking by optimizing Core Web Vitals metrics.

items.task: Measure current Core Web Vitals using Google PageSpeed Insights
items.description: Get baseline metrics for LCP, INP, and CLS

items.task: Optimize images (compress, lazy load, modern formats)
items.description: Images are often the biggest contributor to LCP issues

items.task: Minimize JavaScript and defer non-critical scripts
items.description: Reduce blocking JavaScript to improve INP

items.task: Implement a Content Delivery Network (CDN)
items.description: Serve content from servers closer to your users

items.task: Fix layout shifts by reserving space for dynamic content
items.description: Use CSS to prevent unexpected layout changes

items.task: Enable browser caching and compression
items.description: Reduce server response time and file sizes

items.task: Use web fonts efficiently (limit fonts, use font-display)
items.description: Prevent font loading from blocking page rendering

items.task: Monitor Core Web Vitals in Google Search Console
items.description: Track improvements over time and identify remaining issues

schema-markup.title: Getting Started with Schema Markup
schema-markup.description: Implement structured data to help search engines understand your content better.

items.task: Choose relevant schema types for your content
items.description: Select from Article, Product, Event, FAQ, Recipe, etc.

items.task: Use Google's Structured Data Markup Helper
items.description: Generate initial schema code for your pages

items.task: Implement JSON-LD format (Google's preferred method)
items.description: Add schema in the page head without modifying HTML

items.task: Add FAQ schema for Q&A content
items.description: Enable FAQ rich snippets in search results

items.task: Implement BreadcrumbList schema for navigation
items.description: Help users and search engines understand site structure

items.task: Add Article schema with author and publish date
items.description: Provide publication metadata to search engines

items.task: Validate schema using Google's Rich Results Test
items.description: Ensure your markup is correct and error-free

items.task: Monitor rich snippets in Google Search Console
items.description: Track which rich results are appearing in search results

e-e-a-t.title: Getting Started with E-E-A-T
e-e-a-t.description: Build Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness signals.

items.task: Create detailed author bios with credentials
items.description: Display expertise, certifications, and experience prominently

items.task: Cite authoritative sources and link to them
items.description: Show that your content is based on reliable information

items.task: Add customer testimonials and case studies
items.description: Demonstrate real-world results and user satisfaction

items.task: Build backlinks from authoritative websites
items.description: Get endorsements from trusted sources in your industry

items.task: Display trust signals (SSL certificate, privacy policy, contact info)
items.description: Show visitors that your site is secure and legitimate

items.task: Keep content fresh and up-to-date
items.description: Regularly update pages with current information

items.task: Share your first-hand experience and knowledge
items.description: Demonstrate personal expertise and real-world experience

items.task: Build a strong brand presence and reputation
items.description: Establish recognition and trust in your industry

topical-authority.title: Getting Started with Topical Authority
topical-authority.description: Build comprehensive expertise in a specific topic area.

items.task: Define your main topic (pillar) and subtopics (clusters)
items.description: Map out all aspects of your chosen subject

items.task: Create a pillar page covering the main topic comprehensively
items.description: Write a 3,000+ word guide on your main topic

items.task: Create cluster content for each subtopic
items.description: Write 5-10 detailed articles on specific aspects

items.task: Link cluster articles back to the pillar page
items.description: Use keyword-rich anchor text for internal links

items.task: Link between related cluster articles
items.description: Create a web of interconnected content

items.task: Use consistent terminology and language
items.description: Reinforce topic relevance through vocabulary

items.task: Build backlinks to your pillar page
items.description: Get external links pointing to your main topic page

items.task: Monitor rankings for all related keywords
items.description: Track improvement across your topic cluster

backlinks.title: Getting Started with Backlinks
backlinks.description: Build a high-quality backlink profile to boost authority.

items.task: Audit your current backlink profile
items.description: Use tools like Ahrefs or Semrush to see who links to you

items.task: Identify and disavow toxic or spammy backlinks
items.description: Remove low-quality links that could hurt your rankings

items.task: Create link-worthy content (guides, research, tools)
items.description: Make content so valuable that others want to link to it

items.task: Reach out to relevant websites for guest posting
items.description: Write articles for industry publications with backlinks

items.task: Build relationships with influencers and journalists
items.description: Network with people who can link to your content

items.task: Get listed in industry directories and resource pages
items.description: Find niche directories where your site belongs

items.task: Create original research or data that gets cited
items.description: Publish studies or statistics that others will reference

items.task: Monitor competitor backlinks and replicate
items.description: Find where competitors get links and pursue similar opportunities

mobile-first-indexing.title: Getting Started with Mobile-First Indexing
mobile-first-indexing.description: Ensure your site is optimized for mobile-first indexing.

items.task: Test mobile usability using Google Mobile-Friendly Test
items.description: Check if your site passes mobile usability requirements

items.task: Implement responsive design or dynamic serving
items.description: Ensure your site works well on all screen sizes

items.task: Ensure mobile content matches desktop content
items.description: Don't hide important content on mobile

items.task: Optimize mobile page speed
items.description: Mobile users expect fast-loading pages

items.task: Make buttons and links touch-friendly
items.description: Use adequate spacing for mobile interaction

items.task: Avoid intrusive interstitials and pop-ups
items.description: Don't block content with ads or overlays on mobile

items.task: Test mobile rendering in Google Search Console
items.description: Use Fetch as Google to see how Googlebot sees mobile pages

items.task: Monitor mobile rankings and traffic
items.description: Track performance on mobile search results

featured-snippet.title: Getting Started with Featured Snippets
featured-snippet.description: Optimize your content to rank in featured snippets.

items.task: Research keywords with featured snippets in SERPs
items.description: Use SEO tools to find snippet opportunities

items.task: Analyze current featured snippet content
items.description: Study what Google is currently showing

items.task: Create better paragraph answers (40-60 words)
items.description: Write concise, direct answers to questions

items.task: Use lists and tables for structured data
items.description: Format content in ways Google can easily extract

items.task: Add FAQ schema markup to your pages
items.description: Help Google understand Q&A content

items.task: Include relevant images with descriptive alt text
items.description: Visual snippets often get more clicks

items.task: Rank in top 10 for your target keyword first
items.description: Featured snippets come from top 10 results

items.task: Monitor featured snippet rankings
items.description: Track which snippets you've won

long-tail-keywords.title: Getting Started with Long-Tail Keywords
long-tail-keywords.description: Target specific, lower-volume keywords with higher intent.

items.task: Use keyword research tools to find long-tail variations
items.description: Tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, and Ubersuggest show long-tail keywords

items.task: Analyze search intent for long-tail keywords
items.description: Understand what users are looking for with these queries

items.task: Create content targeting 3-5 word phrases
items.description: Focus on specific, conversational queries

items.task: Optimize for question-based long-tail keywords
items.description: Target 'how to', 'what is', 'why' queries

items.task: Build content around long-tail keyword clusters
items.description: Create related content around similar long-tail terms

items.task: Target location-specific long-tail keywords
items.description: Include city names and local modifiers

items.task: Monitor rankings for long-tail keywords
items.description: Track progress in Google Search Console

items.task: Optimize conversion funnels for long-tail traffic
items.description: Long-tail traffic often converts better
